questions.text: Is the total cash collected at tills reconciled with the POS/Billing System for each shift?
Is the physical cash at tills counted and matched with the system generated cash report at the end of each day?
Is the cash-in-safe amount verified and logged at the start and end of each business day?
Is the float/imprest amount maintained as per the authorized master allocation?
Are all cash deposits picked up by the CMS agency on the scheduled date?
Is there a delay of more than 2 days in cash handover to the collection agency?
Is the cash deposited amount matching with the cash sales amount for each day?
Is CMS acknowledgement receipt maintained for each cash pickup?
Are debit/credit card settlements reconciled with the POS/billing system daily?
Are chargebacks and disputed card transactions tracked and resolved within SLA?
Is the card terminal (EDC machine) functioning properly and PCI-DSS compliant?
Are UPI payments verified and reconciled with the bank statement and POS reports?
Are UPI QR codes displayed prominently at all billing counters?
Are failed UPI transactions refunded within the stipulated timeline?
Are credit notes issued only against valid return transactions with proper approval?
Is dual authorization implemented for credit notes above the threshold value?
Is a credit note register maintained and reviewed by the store manager weekly?
Are all running promotions/schemes authorized by the HO and documented?
Are scheme discounts applied correctly at the billing counter as per HO circular?
Are expired/discontinued schemes removed from the system and POS promptly?
Are free/sample items issued under promotions tracked and reconciled against scheme allocation?
Is the FIFO (First In First Out) method followed for all perishable and near-expiry inventory?
Are expired products identified, segregated, and removed from the sales floor?
Is a near-expiry review conducted weekly and documented in the expiry tracker?
Is the system stock count matching with the physical stock for sampled SKUs?
Are damaged/defective items logged in the shrinkage register and segregated?
Is the receiving dock process followed — GRN matched with PO and invoice?
Are fire extinguishers serviced, accessible, and within validity?
Are emergency exits clearly marked, unobstructed, and functional?
Is periodic fire drill conducted and documented as per norms?
Is housekeeping checklist followed and signed off daily?
Are pest control measures in place and pest control records maintained?
Are FSSAI/trade licenses displayed and within validity?
Are staff trained on food safety and hygiene practices with training records maintained?

cash_reconciliation.remarks: Cash short by Rs. 2000 - under investigation
Minor discrepancy - petty cash adjustment pending

observations.observation: Cash difference of Rs. 2000 found during physical verification on 2-Nov-25. Tills cash short against POS report.
observations.action_plan: Investigate root cause, review CCTV footage, reconcile with cashier shift reports

observations.observation: CMS pickup delay of 3 days observed on 2-Nov-25. Cash handover exceeded 2-day SLA.
observations.action_plan: Reschedule CMS pickup frequency, escalate to CMS provider, ensure daily pickup for high-volume days

observations.observation: 6 expired items found on sales floor during Store Visit. Items include Face Cream (expired Jul-25) and Body Lotion (expired Aug-25).
observations.action_plan: Remove all expired stock immediately, implement weekly FIFO checks, retrain staff on expiry monitoring

observations.observation: Credit notes worth Rs. 15,000 issued without dual authorization. 3 credit notes lacked manager approval stamp.
observations.action_plan: Implement mandatory dual-authorization for all credit notes above Rs. 2000, conduct credit note register review

observations.observation: UPI reconciliation pending for 3 consecutive days (3-Nov to 5-Nov). Bank statement not matched with POS.
observations.action_plan: Complete daily UPI reconciliation without fail, assign dedicated resource for digital payment reconciliation

observations.observation: Fire extinguisher in aisle 3 found expired (servicing due Aug-25). Emergency exit near stockroom partially blocked by cartons.
observations.action_plan: Service all fire extinguishers immediately, clear emergency exits, conduct fire safety audit

observations.observation: Physical stock count for 5 sampled SKUs showed variance >5%. System showed 120 units vs 108 physical for ART003.
observations.action_plan: Conduct full cycle count for high-value SKUs, investigate shrinkage, review CCTV for stockroom access

observations.observation: Two promotional schemes (Diwali Bonanza, Festive Pack) still active in POS system despite HO circular cancelling them on 1-Nov-25.
observations.action_plan: Remove expired schemes from POS immediately, implement scheme expiry alerts in system

observations.observation: GRN for supplier delivery on 3-Nov-25 not matched with PO. 2 line items received without corresponding purchase order.
observations.action_plan: Reject unmatched deliveries, train receiving team on GRN-PO matching process, escalate to procurement

observations.observation: Cash deposit for Nov 3 picked up after 3 days due to CMS route change. Rs. 38,000 held in safe beyond SLA.
observations.action_plan: Coordinate with CMS for route optimization, maintain temporary insurance for excess cash holding

issues.title: Cash shortfall of Rs. 2000 at tills
issues.desc: Physical cash count at tills showed Rs. 2000 less than POS system report. Discrepancy noted during shift-end reconciliation on 2-Nov-25.

issues.title: CMS pickup delayed beyond 2-day SLA
issues.desc: Cash Management Service pickup was delayed to 3 days for Nov 2 deposit. Rs. 40,000 held in safe beyond permissible duration.

issues.title: 6 expired products found on sales floor
issues.desc: Multiple expired items including Face Cream (Jul-25), Body Lotion (Aug-25), and Toothpaste (Sep-25) found on active shelves. FIFO not followed.

issues.title: Credit notes issued without dual authorization
issues.desc: 3 credit notes totaling Rs. 15,000 were issued without the required manager counter-signature. Process bypass noted.

issues.title: UPI reconciliation backlog — 3 days pending
issues.desc: UPI payments for Nov 3-5 not reconciled against bank statement. Digital payment reconciliation SOP not followed.

issues.title: Expired fire extinguisher and blocked exit
issues.desc: Fire extinguisher in aisle 3 past service date. Emergency exit near stockroom partially blocked by incoming cartons.

issues.title: Stock variance >5% for sampled SKUs
issues.desc: Physical stock count vs system showed 10% variance for ART003 (Instant Noodles). System: 120 units, Physical: 108 units.

issues.title: Discontinued schemes still active in POS
issues.desc: Diwali Bonanza and Festive Pack promotions still running in POS despite HO cancellation circular dated 1-Nov-25.

issues.title: GRN not matched with PO for supplier delivery
issues.desc: 2 line items in Nov-3 delivery received without matching purchase order. GRN-PO matching process not followed at receiving dock.

issues.title: FSSAI license expired — not renewed
issues.desc: FSSAI food license displayed at store expired on 30-Sep-25. Renewal application not submitted. Regulatory non-compliance.

issues.title: Housekeeping checklist not signed for 4 days
issues.desc: Daily housekeeping sign-off missing for Nov 1-4. No evidence of routine cleaning schedule being followed.

use_case_mapping.description: Maps each data area to the audit questions that consume it and the use cases it supports

columns: Cash Sales as per sales Report
Float and Imprest allocated to store as per Master
use_cases: Verify physical cash matches POS/system-reported cash for each shift
Detect cash shortages or surpluses at tills and safe
Validate float/imprest is maintained per authorized allocation
Data Analyst auto-flags any non-zero difference for auditor review
Track daily cash deposit compliance with CMS agency schedules
Flag delays exceeding 2-day SLA for cash handover
Detect deposit shortages (cash deposited < cash sales) for investigation
Monitor CMS pickup patterns and identify route inefficiencies
Identify expired products still on sales floor (FIFO non-compliance)
Track near-expiry items requiring markdown or return-to-vendor action
Quantify financial exposure from expired inventory (Quantity x MRP)
Data Analyst auto-generates expiry risk report per store
Master data for all store operations and audit scheduling
Regional grouping for dashboard analytics and audit planning
Store category-based checklist assignment (Flagship vs Compact vs Kiosk)
Manager responsibility mapping for issue assignment
Track quarterly audit score trends per store
Identify declining stores for increased audit frequency
Benchmark store performance across regions
Feed into dashboard top/bottom store rankings
Record audit-level findings with risk classification
Track action plans and accountability for each observation
Monitor resolution timelines and overdue corrective actions
Feed into management reporting for audit committee reviews
Define structured audit checklist grouped by process and sub-process
Classify question types: Store Visit (physical), Structured data/DA (automated), Unstructured data (review)
Link questions to data sheets for auto-populated answers via Data Analyst
Weight questions for scoring (1-5 scale) and mark critical questions for auto-issue-raising
Enable photo/video evidence collection for Store Visit type questions
